fr.label: Marketing et communication
fr.description: Communiqués, publications, newsletters, plans éditoriaux, briefs créatifs et bilans de campagne.

en.label: Marketing and communication
en.description: Press releases, posts, newsletters, editorial plans, creative briefs and campaign reports.

fr.text: Aucune affirmation qu'on ne peut pas prouver : pas de « leader », « n°1 », « le meilleur » ni de chiffre sans source.

en.text: No claim that cannot be proven: no « leader », « number one », « the best », and no figure without a source.

guardrails.agent: Never write a superlative, ranking, comparative or performance claim (« leader », « n°1 », « le plus rapide », « 30 % d'économies ») unless the documents provide its proof; list every factual claim and figure the text makes under « Points to confirm » with its source.

fr.text: Un client, un partenaire ou une personne n'est nommé ou cité que si son accord figure dans vos documents.

en.text: A client, partner or person is named or quoted only if their consent appears in your documents.

guardrails.agent: Name or quote a client, partner or person only when the documents show they agreed to it; otherwise use a neutral description (« une PME vaudoise du bâtiment ») and say so under « Points to confirm ». Never invent a quotation or testimonial.

fr.text: Prix, dates, offres et conditions sont repris exactement de vos documents ; une promotion a toujours ses conditions.

en.text: Prices, dates, offers and conditions are taken exactly from your documents; a promotion always comes with its conditions.

guardrails.agent: Copy prices, dates, promotional offers and their conditions exactly from the documents; when an offer has a limit (dates, stock, eligibility) state it, and never present an expired or unconfirmed offer as current.

fr.text: Les chiffres d'une campagne sont ceux des exports : l'agent montre ses calculs et ne compare pas à des moyennes du marché inventées.

en.text: A campaign's figures are those of the exports: the agent shows its calculations and does not compare with invented market averages.

guardrails.agent: In campaign figures, quote each value from the named export, show the calculation of every rate or ratio, and never compare with an industry benchmark that is not in the documents.

fr.label: Communiqué de presse
fr.hint: Qu'annoncez-vous, quand ? Ex. « Communiqué pour l'ouverture de notre atelier à Yverdon le 15 janvier »
fr.attach: Les faits de l'annonce (note interne, chiffres, dates), les citations validées, la présentation de l'entreprise
fr.produces: Un communiqué : titre, chapeau, faits (qui, quoi, où, quand, pourquoi), citation, à propos, contact presse
checks: Les citations et l'accord des personnes citées
Le contact presse et la date d'embargo

en.label: Press release
en.hint: What are you announcing, when? E.g. “Press release for the opening of our workshop in Yverdon on 15 January”
en.attach: The facts of the announcement (internal note, figures, dates), the approved quotes, the company profile
en.produces: A press release: headline, lead, facts (who, what, where, when, why), quote, about us, press contact
checks: The quotes and consent of the people quoted
The press contact and embargo date

templates.mission:
Write a press release. What the person asked for: {subject}

Use the press-release form instead of a social post: place and date line, a factual headline, a lead paragraph that answers who, what, where, when and why, then two or three short paragraphs of facts, one quotation taken word for word from the documents (or « [citation à fournir] »), the « À propos » paragraph and the press contact. Aim for 300 to 450 words, neutral journalistic tone, no advertising adjectives. Give two alternative headlines at the end.

fr.label: Publication LinkedIn
fr.hint: Quel sujet, quel message ? Ex. « Post sur notre nouvelle apprentie et la formation duale »
fr.attach: Les faits ou l'article source, votre charte éditoriale, une photo prévue (description)
fr.produces: Une publication de 120 à 250 mots avec accroche, message, appel à l'action et deux accroches alternatives
checks: Les personnes nommées et leur accord
Le lien ou l'appel à l'action

en.label: LinkedIn post
en.hint: Which topic, which message? E.g. “Post about our new apprentice and dual training”
en.attach: The facts or source article, your editorial charter, the planned photo (description)
en.produces: A 120-250 word post with hook, message, call to action and two alternative hooks
checks: The link or call to action

templates.mission:
Write a LinkedIn post for the organisation's page. What the person asked for: {subject}

Open with a concrete fact rather than a slogan, keep short paragraphs readable on a phone, and end with one clear call to action. Follow the team's editorial charter for tone, hashtags and emojis when the memory has one; otherwise use none. Mention any person or partner only as the documents allow.

fr.label: Newsletter
fr.hint: Quelle édition, quels sujets ? Ex. « Newsletter de décembre : horaires des fêtes, nouveau service, témoignage client »
fr.attach: Les sujets et leurs faits (notes, articles, offres), l'édition précédente pour le ton
fr.produces: Une newsletter : objet et pré-en-tête, introduction, 3 à 5 rubriques courtes avec leur lien, appel à l'action
checks: Les dates, prix et conditions des offres

en.label: Newsletter
en.hint: Which issue, which topics? E.g. “December newsletter: holiday hours, new service, client story”
en.attach: The topics and their facts (notes, articles, offers), the previous issue for tone
en.produces: A newsletter: subject line and preheader, intro, 3 to 5 short sections with their link, call to action
checks: Dates, prices and conditions of the offers

templates.mission:
Write a newsletter issue. What the person asked for: {subject}

Give a subject line under 50 characters with two alternatives, and a preheader. Write a two-sentence introduction, then one short section per topic (title, 40 to 90 words, link or « [lien à fournir] »), most useful topic first. Match the tone of the previous issue when it is attached. End with a single call to action and the unsubscribe mention as a placeholder.

fr.label: Plan éditorial
fr.hint: Sur quelle période, quels canaux ? Ex. « Plan éditorial janvier-mars : LinkedIn, newsletter, site »
fr.attach: Les temps forts de l'entreprise (événements, lancements, salons), les objectifs, votre charte éditoriale
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : date, canal, thème, format, message clé, responsable, statut, source

en.label: Editorial plan
en.hint: Over which period, which channels? E.g. “Editorial plan January-March: LinkedIn, newsletter, website”
en.attach: The company's key dates (events, launches, trade fairs), the objectives, your editorial charter
en.produces: An Excel table: date, channel, theme, format, key message, owner, status, source

templates.mission:
Build an editorial calendar. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Date de publication, Canal, Thème, Format, Message clé, Objectif, Responsable, Statut, Source, À vérifier. Anchor each publication on a key date from the documents (announce before, cover during, follow up after) and keep each channel's rhythm as given in the request or the charter. Leave Responsable empty when no owner is named. Sort by date; one row per publication.

fr.label: Brief créatif
fr.description: Briefer une agence ou un graphiste
fr.hint: Pour quel projet ? Ex. « Brief pour l'affiche et les visuels du salon Habitat-Jardin de mars »
fr.attach: Le contexte du projet, le budget, la charte graphique, des exemples appréciés
fr.produces: Un brief : contexte, objectif, cible, message unique, livrables et formats, contraintes, budget, calendrier
checks: Le budget et les dates de livraison
La liste des livrables et formats

en.label: Creative brief
en.hint: For which project? E.g. “Brief for the poster and visuals of the Habitat-Jardin fair in March”
en.attach: The project context, the budget, the brand guidelines, examples you like
en.produces: A brief: context, objective, audience, single message, deliverables and formats, constraints, budget, schedule
checks: The list of deliverables and formats

templates.mission:
Write a creative brief for an agency or designer. What the person asked for: {subject}

State the context, the measurable objective, the target audience and the single message in one sentence. List every deliverable with its format, size and language, the mandatory elements (logo, legal mentions, brand rules) and what to avoid. Give budget, milestones (briefing, first proposal, corrections, final delivery) and approvers as written, with « [à définir] » for any that is missing.

fr.label: Page web ou fiche produit
fr.description: Un texte clair qui fait agir
fr.hint: Quel produit ou service ? Ex. « Fiche produit de la nouvelle offre d'entretien annuel des chaudières »
fr.attach: La fiche technique, les prix et conditions, les questions fréquentes des clients
fr.produces: Un texte de page : titre, accroche, bénéfices, caractéristiques, prix et conditions, questions fréquentes, appel à l'action
checks: Chaque bénéfice annoncé et sa preuve
Le titre et la description pour les moteurs de recherche

en.label: Web page or product sheet
en.hint: Which product or service? E.g. “Product sheet for the new annual boiler maintenance offer”
en.attach: The technical sheet, prices and conditions, customers' frequent questions
en.produces: Page copy: title, hook, benefits, features, price and conditions, FAQs, call to action
checks: Every benefit claimed and its proof

templates.mission:
Write the copy of a web page or product sheet. What the person asked for: {subject}

Structure it as: page title, a one-sentence hook, three to five benefits each tied to a feature from the technical sheet, a features list, price and conditions exactly as given, three to five questions and answers from the customer questions attached, and one call to action. Add a search-engine title (under 60 characters) and description (under 155 characters). Length may go up to 450 words.

fr.label: Compte rendu de campagne
fr.hint: Quelle campagne ? Ex. « Bilan de la campagne d'automne : annonces, newsletter et salon »
fr.attach: Les exports de résultats (annonces, e-mailing, site), le budget et les factures, les objectifs de départ
fr.produces: Un bilan : objectifs vs résultats, chiffres par canal, coûts, ce qui a marché ou non, recommandations

en.label: Campaign report
en.hint: Which campaign? E.g. “Review of the autumn campaign: ads, newsletter and trade fair”
en.attach: The results exports (ads, e-mailing, website), the budget and invoices, the initial objectives
en.produces: A review: objectives vs results, figures per channel, costs, what worked or not, recommendations

templates.mission:
Write the report of a marketing campaign. What the person asked for: {subject}

Compare each objective with its result in a table. Give figures per channel (reach, clicks, leads, sales, cost) from the exports, compute rates and cost per lead or per sale with the calculation shown, and compare actual spend with the budget. When two exports disagree on a figure, show both. End with what to keep, stop or test next time, each tied to a figure.

fr.label: Relecture avant publication
fr.hint: Quel support ? Ex. « Relire la brochure 2027 avant impression, surtout les chiffres et promesses »
fr.attach: Le support à relire (texte, brochure, page), les documents qui prouvent les chiffres, votre charte
fr.produces: Une relecture : passages problématiques cités, problème (preuve, cohérence, ton, mention manquante) et formulation proposée
checks: Les mentions légales à faire valider

en.label: Pre-publication review
en.hint: Which material? E.g. “Review the 2027 brochure before printing, especially figures and promises”
en.attach: The material to review (text, brochure, page), the documents that prove the figures, your charter
en.produces: A review: problematic passages quoted, issue (proof, consistency, tone, missing mention) and suggested wording

templates.mission:
Review a piece of marketing material before publication. What the person asked for: {subject}

Quote each passage that raises an issue and classify it: claim without proof in the documents, figure inconsistent with its source, superlative or comparison, person or client named without consent, departure from the charter, typo or inconsistency. Propose a sober replacement wording for each. List mentions that seem missing (price conditions, offer dates) as questions for a specialist, not as legal advice.

fr.title: Charte éditoriale
fr.description: Ton, vocabulaire, règles par canal (hashtags, émojis, longueur) et mots interdits — à compléter par l'équipe.
fr.body:
Cette note dit à l'agent comment l'entreprise s'exprime.

- Ton en trois mots : [À compléter : ex. sobre, concret, chaleureux]
- Vouvoiement ou tutoiement selon le canal : [À compléter]
- Nom de l'entreprise et des produits (orthographe exacte) : [À compléter]
- Mots à utiliser / à éviter : [À compléter]

| Canal | Longueur | Hashtags | Émojis | Rythme |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [À compléter : ex. LinkedIn] | [À compléter] | [À compléter] | [À compléter] | [À compléter : ex. 2 par semaine] |
